name: What are the key factors to consider when choosing a South Florida neighborhood for a waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: What are the key factors to consider when choosing a South Florida neighborhood for a waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a waterfront neighborhood, evaluate factors such as property type (single-family, condo), access to open water (direct ocean, canal, bay), boating restrictions like fixed bridges, and proximity to amenities or work. Consider also the flood zone implications and insurance costs specific to waterfront properties. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution helps buyers navigate these considerations, offering insights into how different neighborhoods in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties align with specific lifestyle needs and boating preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key factors include property type, water access, boating restrictions, flood zones, and proximity to amenities.
